mesh_read_obj — FILEIO mesh op

• Data kinds: text → mesh

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mesh_read_obj(data) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.mesh_read_obj(data); from the registry, opsfileio.get("mesh_read_obj"))

Usage

Read Wavefront OBJ v and f records (including v//vn) and return a triangle mesh.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

vn は構文として許すが mesh sort は幾何だけなので返さない。mtllib / usemtl と material は読まず、形状に影響させない。呼び出し例: mesh = mesh_read_obj(obj_text)。
